card.name: Plasticizer and pesticide chemical names
card.fires_on: The opening bracket or first letter piece right after a plasticizer or pesticide chemical name, where an abbreviation like DEHP or DDT comes next. It is seen in lists of plastics additives and infusion set materials.

modes.label: Bracket before abbreviation
modes.description: The open parenthesis after phthalate or trimellitate that introduces DEHP or TOTM.
